caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with an oval-shaped top and extending leaves, supported by eight turned legs. The wood is illustrated in various shades of brown, with the tabletop and legs showing different tones to depict depth and light reflection. There is a single drawer with a round knob in the center-front of the table. The legs are connected by horizontal and diagonal stretchers, also turned and carved, contributing to the stability and decorative aspect of the table. The drawing is outlined with a black border, and the paper background is a light beige color. The lines and colors are applied with precision to show the details in the wood grain and joinery.
title: Gate-leg Table
